was: Inductions serve to gather you up so you can access quiet stuff. They're not about surrendering or playing asleep or obeying someone. Sometimes it's nice to have someone do an actual induction for you if you're sober but distracted or analytical or otherwise not very trancey. If on the other hand, you're already pretty trancey for whatever reason (meditation, loveyhuasca, lucid dreaming, grief, music, prayer, tired, whatever...) and feel like you're in touch with the deeper stuff already, it can be good to skip straight to the orientation/containment part rather than going deeper.

was: 3. Put yourself in a place where you can safely do this. Don't do this if you're driving, in the water, operating machinery, or otherwise need to be attending to yourself or other people. (The later part of this can be used to help orient you if you're already open, but don't use it to make yourself deeper if you're not stable.)

was: IV. Deciding to do it . How will you coax yourself to do this? Make it spacious? Make it warm and held? Something else? Preview, if you can, what you are going to do: will you close your eyes? Will you come out and go back in again? What will you do at the end? If you are going to use a recording, read the script if you can. Know that you can say stop at any time and the induction will end. If you want to change something, say less if you want it to be asking for less from you, or quiet and the talking will stop. You don't need to ask any parts for permission to stop, even if a part tells you that you do.

was: To turn this off, stop rehearsing it, take it out of any recordings that you have, stop having it in any apps that are active, and go back to using your regular induction that you have been using. You can say that you won't use it anymore when you are awake, but realize that just saying that it is gone won't make it go away. If you are finding that you are responding to it when you don't want to, or you are having problems with being disoriented after using it, get some help from someone who is qualified to help you. If you want to keep it in, you can, but only for the use of starting a session at a later time when you want to. For now, this will be over when you come out of it.
